urlText: Trains run to a changed timetable and stopping pattern
content:
Tuesday 27 January
  • From 9.40pm to 1.30am, trains via the Airport start and end at Central due to City Circle trackwork.
  • T8 trains do not run between Sydenham and the City. T4 trains run between Sydenham and Bondi Junction, making extra stops at St Peters and Erskineville.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
